lines: Inscription Gate: You can build the Inscription Gate, a Runecarver portal with pink-violet runes. Shift + use on it opens the map of every portal in the world: pick one and inscribe the link, and everyone who enters the gate steps out there.

Azurite Sight: Azurite veins within your view radius are marked on the map and minimap: plain, corrupted and divine each with its own icon. A vein mined out by more than three quarters is no longer marked.

Divine Touch: +2% chance for divine azurite; Each chisel hit on a plain azurite vein outside the mist has a chance to turn it divine, with the same lightning as a heavenly strike. Any chisel works, in any biome.

Ascendant Rune: +10% chance that a property added by a rune rises one tier; When a rune adds or raises a property, it has a chance to rise one tier more as a separate step, beyond the item's level limit. You see a second flash, hear a chime and read "+1 affix tier".
Perfect Inscription: +10% chance that a property rolled by a rune takes the highest value of its tier; A property rolled by a rune (Fate included) has a chance to take the highest value of its tier.

Portal Crate: Away from a workbench, dismantling a portal packs it into a crate that keeps its tag, author, durability and Inscription Gate link. Place it back from the crate anywhere. A crate cannot pass through a portal.

Relic Passage: Dragon eggs for summoning, Hildir's chests and dvergr parts (charred cogwheels, dvergr needles, mechanical springs) go through portals, with no portal toll. Ore and metal are not included.

Vacuum Chest: Unlocks the Vacuum Chest at the Rune Carver Table. It takes finished goods from smelters, kilns, spinning wheels and windmills around it and feeds them from its contents. Shift + mouse wheel sets the radius, Shift + E the kind of goods it collects.

Chisel Quarrying: Rune chisels also mine stone and ore deposits, like a pickaxe of the same metal: bronze, iron or black metal (flametal hits as hard as black metal). A deposit too hard for that pickaxe is too hard for the chisel. Chisel hits do not train the Pickaxes skill. Azurite veins are mined as before.
new.name: Rare affixes
